P1.text: Plasticity, plain backprop with Adam: mean online accuracy over tasks 751-800 is at least 3 points below tasks 1-50, mean of 3 seeds.

P2.text: Continual backprop with Adam: the same drop is at most 1 point.

P3.text: At task 800, plain backprop with Adam has more than half its hidden units dead; continual backprop under 30%.

P4.text: Plain SGD (rate 0.1) loses less than Adam over the same 800 tasks.

P5.text: A fresh network on each task beats plain backprop's tasks 751-800 by at least 3 points of online accuracy.
